test_openai_prediction_param: test the OpenAI prediction parameter by sending code completion requests with predicted content to gpt-4o-mini
test_openai_web_search: test OpenAI web search by making completion requests to gpt-4o-search-preview and validating URL citation annotations
test_openai_tool_calling: test OpenAI tool calling by sending function definitions to gpt-4.1 and verifying tool call responses
test_openai_codex_stream: test OpenAI codex streaming by sending sync or async streaming completion requests to gpt-5.2-codex model
test_openai_gpt5_reasoning: test GPT-5 reasoning by sending async completion requests with reasoning_effort parameter to gpt-5-mini model
